title: Your First Weekend at Elon University, Shared as Cards
description: A conservative, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence that introduces Elon’s historic core, student resources, recreation spaces, and public gardens.

cards.title: Begin Under the Oaks
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Historic campus
cards.notes: Start beneath the historic oak canopy and locate the setting where new students receive an acorn during New Student Convocation.
cards.short_summary: Connect Elon's oak-filled landscape with the symbolic beginning of a student’s university journey.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon documents Under the Oaks as the New Student Convocation setting where incoming students receive an acorn symbolizing the start of their Elon journey.
cards.source_title: Copy Bank | Elon Brand Guide | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus setting; event participation depends on the official New Student Convocation schedule.

cards.title: Find the Main Building Bell
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Alamance Building
cards.notes: Step inside Alamance Building to identify the bell that survived the 1923 fire and anchors a documented new-student tradition.
cards.short_summary: See a tangible link between Elon’s early campus and its present-day opening ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon states that the Main Building bell survived the 1923 fire, is displayed in Alamance Building, and is touched by incoming students at New Student Convocation.
cards.source_title: Copy Bank | Elon Brand Guide | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Located inside Alamance Building; enter only while the building is open and follow posted access rules.

cards.title: Pause at Fonville Fountain
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Scott Plaza
cards.notes: Walk to Scott Plaza, photograph the named fountain, and use this prominent landmark to orient yourself within the historic core.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable campus landmark makes a practical early waypoint between historic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon’s New Student Programs identifies Fonville Fountain as the large fountain outside Alamance Hall on Scott Plaza.
cards.source_title: Elon Lingo | New Student Programs | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark on Scott Plaza; observe any temporary event barriers or campus notices.

cards.title: Learn the Moseley Center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Campus-life hub
cards.notes: Locate the front desk, student-organization offices, fireplace lounge, and game area before your first full weekend begins.
cards.short_summary: Get acquainted with the campus hub that combines student services, gathering rooms, games, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon describes Moseley Center as a campus-activity hub with Student Life departments, organization offices, meeting rooms, mail services, dining, a fireplace, and games.
cards.source_title: About the Center | Moseley Center | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Building and service availability varies; check posted notices or the front desk before relying on a specific amenity.

cards.title: Follow the Trees of Elon Trail
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Core campus
cards.notes: Open the university’s tree map and follow part of the 1.25-mile route, matching numbered plaques to individual tree entries.
cards.short_summary: Turn a morning campus walk into a self-guided introduction to Elon’s labeled tree collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon provides an interactive map for a 1.25-mile core-campus walk featuring 125 trees identified by numbered plaques.
cards.source_title: Campus Maps | About Elon | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor self-guided route; the university estimates 90 minutes for the complete walk.

cards.title: Inspect Lambert Knot Garden
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Botanical Garden
cards.notes: Use the botanical-garden listing to find this named specialty garden and examine plant labels without entering planted beds.
cards.short_summary: Focus the campus-wide botanical garden experience on one distinctive, officially named garden.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon lists Lambert Knot Garden among the specialty areas of the university’s public, year-round botanical garden.
cards.source_title: Botanical Garden | Facilities Management | Elon University
cards.access_notes: The campus botanical garden is open to the public year-round; remain on established paths and respect plantings.

cards.title: Check In at Koury Athletic Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Find the Campus Recreation office and review current facility access before planning a workout, swim, or future program.
cards.short_summary: Learn where Elon posts changing recreation schedules before committing to a particular facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon’s Campus Recreation hours page identifies the Campus Recreation office in Koury Athletic Center 101 and publishes current facility schedules.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | Campus Recreation | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by term and facility. Consult the current schedule and follow Phoenix Card or eligibility requirements.

cards.title: Map Out Belk Library
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 308 North O’Kelly Avenue
cards.notes: Locate the service desk, scan the three floor maps, and identify a suitable research or study area for your first assignments.
cards.short_summary: Use a low-pressure weekend visit to learn the layout of Elon’s principal campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon identifies Carol Grotnes Belk Library at 308 North O’Kelly Avenue and says it provides collections, technology, research, study, and collaboration spaces.
cards.source_title: About Us | Carol Grotnes Belk Library | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s current hours before visiting; some services or borrowing privileges require university affiliation.

cards.title: Try the Moseley Game Lounge
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Moseley first floor
cards.notes: Bring your Phoenix Card, ask the front desk about available equipment, and choose a casual table game with new classmates.
cards.short_summary: End Saturday with a structured indoor activity in a staffed campus gathering place.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon says the Moseley Student Center offers ping pong, pool, foosball, shuffleboard, and a Nintendo Switch, with equipment checked out at the front desk.
cards.source_title: About the Center | Moseley Center | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Game availability and building access can vary; ask the Moseley front desk about current checkout requirements.

cards.title: Close at Numen Lumen Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Numen Lumen Pavilion 110
cards.notes: Locate the Sacred Space and note it as a quiet campus resource before the academic week and recurring gatherings begin.
cards.short_summary: Finish with a calm orientation stop at the home of Elon’s documented reflection gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon identifies Numen Lumen Pavilion 110 as the Sacred Space hosting the academic-year Numen Lumen gathering for stories, music, artistic expression, and reflection.
cards.source_title: Elon Weeks of Welcome | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Enter only when the pavilion is open and no private program is underway; the documented gathering occurs Thursdays, not Sunday.
